Checking md5s

```{r}
mine<-read_tsv("genbank/md5sum.txt") %>% mutate(Type="Mine")
gb<-read_tsv("genbank/gb-md5.tsv") %>% mutate(Type="Theirs")
```


Sigh. Cleaning.

module load seqtk

seqkit seq -v input.fastq > cleaned_output.fastq

gunzip -c original/LFS1363_R2.fastq.gz | tail

zcat original/LFS1363_R2.fastq.gz | awk '{ pos = NR%4; if ( pos == 1) {h=$0} else if (pos == 2) {s=$0} else if (pos==3){c=$0} else if ( pos==0 ) {q=$0; if ( length(q) == length(s) ){printf("%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n", h, s, c, q)}}}' | gzip -c > LFS1363_R2.fastq.gz

check:
gunzip -c original/LFS1363_R2.fastq.gz | wc
1981175 2476470 179552256
gunzip -c LFS1363_R2.fastq.gz | wc
1981172 2476465 179551975

Seems to work

```{sh, eval=FALSE}
for f in original/*.fastq.gz; do zcat $f | awk '{ pos = NR%4; if ( pos == 1) {h=$0} else if (pos == 2) {s=$0} else if (pos==3){c=$0} else if ( pos==0 ) {q=$0; if ( length(q) == length(s) ){printf("%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n", h, s, c, q)}}}' | gzip -c > `basename $f`; done;
```
